description:
## Saiyan007 1.2.0

Adds two app patches to the existing Morphe collection:

- **SevenGrid Pro** — `app.sevengrid`: Pro habits, themes, history, statistics,
  and reminders. Pro is enabled at offline startup and retained through
  customer-info refreshes and restore flows.
- **Sensu Pro** — `com.piyush.pie`: Pro and all theme entitlements, with local
  overlay feature gates enabled.
- Shared Google Play installer-source fix for all supported apps.
- Includes the existing **Saiyan007** patch for Shima.

Download **Saiyan007-1.2.0.mpp** and import it into Morphe, or refresh the
**AsrOfficialDev/Saiyan007** source. Select the patch matching your app.

**App-version selection is unrestricted.** Structural checks detect
incompatible layouts; SevenGrid currently requires matching Hermes v96 bytecode.

Build, patch application, APK signature, bytecode, and resource checks passed on
**SevenGrid 1.5.2 (80)**, **Sensu 0.1.1 (3)**, and **Shima 0.4.0 (7)**.
SevenGrid's Hermes checksum and isolated entitlement flows also passed.
On-device testing is pending.

[Verification report](https://github.com/AsrOfficialDev/Saiyan007/blob/v1.2.0/docs/verification-1.2.0.md)
